contentPattern.default: one cell per contact (cells flow into a 3/2/1 column grid across any number of rows); each cell: name paragraph, role paragraph, phone link (tel:) and email link (mailto:)
contentPattern.alt: one row, two cells: cell 1 = section heading (h2), cell 2 = "See all" link

usage.context: Default: contact detail pages (press contacts grid). alt: section heading row with See All link on vehicle / listing pages.

reuseGuidance: Use default for press contact cards (tel:/mailto: links get icons automatically). Use alt for a heading + See All strip above a card rail.
